lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white stripes visible on the primary dark-grey torso; spacing is approximately uniform with a slight increase in interval width across the central torso section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three anterior line segments situated near the shoulder region terminate mid-torso, failing to traverse the full vertical distance to the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A sparse cluster of approximately 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior flank near the junction of the haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a posterior-medial trajectory; horns exhibit an initial lateral flare from the skull base before curving inward and backward towards the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated apical tip distance is 1.8x the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15% of the total vertical horn length from base to apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two symbiotic birds (oxpeckers) are present on the subject: one attached to the mid-shoulder region and one on the posterior haunch; no physical trauma or scarring is visible on the dermal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white dorsal crest extending from neck to tail; long black ventral fringe; white facial chevron and dual malar spots; high-contrast ochre coloration on the lower limbs starting below the carpus and tarsus.
